verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron is a first-party Postgres module for scheduling recurring jobs with cron syntax, at intervals from every second to once a year. Jobs are created via SQL or the Dashboard, run SQL, database functions or HTTP requests such as Edge Function invocations, and job runs can be monitored. Supabase Queues adds durable background task handling for workflow-style processing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Cron, and explicit documentation of an agent-facing path (MCP tool or CLI command) for creating schedules.
